article.title: Planning a trip to Uzbekistan? Indians can now stay visa-free for 30 days
article.summary: Uzbekistan has announced visa-free entry for Indian citizens for stays of up to 30 days. The move was announced by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev during his talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Tashkent.

article.title: Uzbekistan Introduces 30-Day Visa-Free Entry For Indian Citizens During PM Modi’s Visit
article.summary: In a move to strengthen bilateral commerce, cultural affinity, and people-to-people exchange, Uzbekistan has enabled 30 days of visa-free travel for all Indian citizens.
